ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms allowed licenses, restricted licenses and the ignore-conflict flag are declared; it does not scan components.
offer: Evaluate component licenses against the explicit distribution policy. Conflicting or unknown licensing needs review rather than silently expanding the allow list.

minimal.reason: List the licenses the distribution policy allows. With no list every license is unchecked, so name them.

mid.reason: List the restricted licenses. An unlisted restriction is silently allowed, so name each prohibited license.

maximal.reason: Set ignoring license conflicts to false. Conflicting or unknown licenses need review instead of expanding the allow list silently.

rule.reason: List the licenses the distribution policy allows. With no list every license is unchecked, so name them.
